title: 07 · Customer funnel and usage
description: From app open to a collected order; search; Asks; usage (05 §4 dashboard 07; owner W3-07). Same v_metric_* views as Pulse.

links.title: Alerts
links.tooltip: Every alert links its runbook in docs/runbooks/

options.content: Steps are distinct actors per step in the range (events and orders). A step that needs an event the catalogue does not have yet is left out and listed below. Numbers match Pulse because both read `rollup_daily_platform` and `v_metric_*`.

panels.title: Funnel (distinct actors in range)
panels.description: Distinct customers (signed-in or anonymous) at each step. Location set, product viewed, cart and checkout steps wait for their events (TODO(lead): not catalogued).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 'App opened' AS step, 1 AS n, count(DISTINCT actor_id) AS actors FROM v_metric_app_opens WHERE app = 'customer' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
UNION ALL SELECT 'Searched', 2, count(DISTINCT coalesce(user_id::text, anon_id::text)) FROM events WHERE name = 'search_performed' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
UNION ALL SELECT 'Store viewed', 3, count(DISTINCT coalesce(user_id::text, anon_id::text)) FROM events WHERE name = 'store_viewed' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
UNION ALL SELECT 'Order placed', 4, count(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM v_metric_orders WHERE $__timeFilter(placed_at)
UNION ALL SELECT 'Order accepted', 5, count(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM v_metric_orders WHERE accepted AND $__timeFilter(placed_at)
UNION ALL SELECT 'Collected / delivered', 6, count(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM v_metric_orders WHERE completed AND $__timeFilter(placed_at)
ORDER BY n

panels.title: Order success rate per day
panels.description: (collected + delivered) ÷ placed, per IST day (05 §3).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') AS time, orders_completed::float / nullif(orders_placed, 0) AS success
FROM rollup_daily_platform WHERE $__timeFilter(date) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Conversion by step vs previous period
panels.description: This range against the same length just before it.

targets.rawSql:
WITH cur AS (SELECT count(DISTINCT customer_id) FILTER (WHERE true) AS placed, count(DISTINCT customer_id) FILTER (WHERE completed) AS completed
             FROM v_metric_orders WHERE $__timeFilter(placed_at)),
prev AS (SELECT count(DISTINCT customer_id) AS placed, count(DISTINCT customer_id) FILTER (WHERE completed) AS completed
         FROM v_metric_orders WHERE placed_at >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AND placed_at < $__timeFrom()::timestamptz)
SELECT 'Placed → completed' AS step, round(100.0 * cur.completed / nullif(cur.placed, 0), 1) AS this_period_pct,
       round(100.0 * prev.completed / nullif(prev.placed, 0), 1) AS previous_pct FROM cur, prev

panels.title: New vs returning customers placing orders
panels.description: Customers who placed an order in range, split by whether their first ever order is in the range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN first_at >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz THEN 'new' ELSE 'returning' END AS customers, count(*) AS n
FROM (SELECT o.customer_id, min(f.placed_at) AS first_at FROM v_metric_orders o JOIN v_metric_orders f ON f.customer_id = o.customer_id
      WHERE $__timeFilter(o.placed_at) GROUP BY o.customer_id) x GROUP BY 1

panels.title: Entry source (app opens)
panels.description: app_opened source: direct, push, qr (standee), referral, share.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(props->>'source', 'unknown') AS source, count(*) AS opens, count(DISTINCT coalesce(user_id::text, anon_id::text)) AS actors
FROM events WHERE name = 'app_opened' AND app = 'customer' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Orders by category of the store
panels.description: Orders by the business category of the store.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(c.names->>'en', 'none') AS category, count(*) AS placed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.completed) AS completed
FROM v_metric_orders o JOIN stores s ON s.id = o.store_id JOIN businesses b ON b.id = s.business_id LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = b.category_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(o.placed_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Searches and zero-result rate
panels.description: Searches per hour and the share with no result in radius (alert at 40 % for an hour).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '1h'), count(*) AS searches, avg((NOT has_results)::int) AS zero_result_rate
FROM v_metric_searches WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top queries
panels.description: Most searched queries (k ≥ 10 floor).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT query_norm AS query, sum(searches) AS searches, sum(zero_results) AS zero_results
FROM rollup_daily_search_demand WHERE $__timeFilter(date) GROUP BY 1 HAVING sum(searches) >= 10 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Top zero-result queries
panels.description: Supply gaps: queries with no result in radius (k ≥ 10 floor).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT query_norm AS query, sum(zero_results) AS zero_results
FROM rollup_daily_search_demand WHERE $__timeFilter(date) GROUP BY 1 HAVING sum(zero_results) >= 10 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Radius chosen
panels.description: Distribution of the radius customers searched with.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (radius_m / 1000)::text || ' km' AS radius, count(*) AS searches FROM search_log
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY radius_m ORDER BY radius_m

panels.title: Search source
panels.description: Typed vs voice (D-101).

targets.rawSql: SELECT source, count(*) AS searches FROM search_log WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Search latency p95 (server)
panels.description: Server p95 of the search routes. Result click position needs search_result_clicked (TODO(lead): not catalogued).

panels.title: Ask funnel per city
panels.description: Asks created in range, by the city they were sent in: at least one shop said Yes, an order was placed from a Yes reply, and closed asks no shop answered at all.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(c.name, 'Unknown') AS city, count(*) AS asks,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ask_recipients r WHERE r.ask_id = a.id AND r.answer = 'yes')) AS with_yes,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ask_recipients r JOIN orders o ON o.ask_reply_id = r.id WHERE r.ask_id = a.id)) AS booked_from_reply,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status = 'closed' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ask_recipients r WHERE r.ask_id = a.id AND r.answer IS NOT NULL)) AS closed_no_reply
FROM asks a LEFT JOIN places c ON c.id = a.city_place_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(a.created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Reply rate per city
panels.description: Asks sent to shops in range: the share answered, the Yes share of the answers, and the median time from sending to the answer.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(c.name, 'Unknown') AS city, count(*) AS sent, count(r.replied_at) AS replies,
  count(r.replied_at)::float8 / nullif(count(*), 0) AS reply_rate,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.answer = 'yes')::float8 / nullif(count(r.replied_at), 0) AS yes_share,
  percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM r.replied_at - r.sent_at)) AS median_time_to_reply
FROM ask_recipients r JOIN asks a ON a.id = r.ask_id LEFT JOIN places c ON c.id = a.city_place_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(r.sent_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Asks per store per day vs the daily limit
panels.description: Per IST day: the median and the most asks one store received, and ask_daily_limit_store (platform_settings). A busiest store at the line means shops near it stop getting asks until midnight.

targets.rawSql:
WITH per AS (
  SELECT (r.sent_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date AS day, r.store_id, count(*) AS n
  FROM ask_recipients r WHERE $__timeFilter(r.sent_at) GROUP BY 1, 2)
SELECT per.day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata' AS time,
  percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY per.n) AS median_per_store, max(per.n) AS busiest_store,
  max((ps.value #>> '{}')::int) AS daily_limit
FROM per, platform_settings ps WHERE ps.key = 'ask_daily_limit_store' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Shares, voice search and search assist
panels.description: Events in range by outcome. Refine chips removed have no event of their own yet (search_performed carries only the chips applied).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 'Share created' AS what, count(*) AS events FROM events WHERE name = 'share_created' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
UNION ALL SELECT 'Share link opened', count(*) FROM events WHERE name = 'share_opened' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
UNION ALL (SELECT 'Voice search: ' || (props->>'outcome'), count(*) FROM events WHERE name = 'voice_search_used' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY props->>'outcome')
UNION ALL (SELECT 'Search assist: ' || (props->>'outcome'), count(*) FROM events WHERE name = 'search_assist_used' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY props->>'outcome')
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: DAU / WAU / MAU
panels.description: Distinct customers with app_opened that day / 7 d / 30 d (05 §3).

targets.rawSql: SELECT (date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') AS time, dau, wau, mau FROM rollup_daily_platform WHERE $__timeFilter(date) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Stickiness (DAU / MAU)
panels.description: DAU ÷ MAU.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') AS time, dau::float / nullif(mau, 0) AS stickiness FROM rollup_daily_platform WHERE $__timeFilter(date) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Sessions per user (range)
panels.description: session_started ÷ distinct actors. Session length needs a session_ended event (TODO(lead)).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*)::float / nullif(count(DISTINCT coalesce(user_id::text, anon_id::text)), 0) AS value
FROM events WHERE name = 'session_started' AND app = 'customer' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)

panels.title: Language mix
panels.description: Languages chosen (lang_changed).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(props->>'lang', 'unknown') AS lang, count(*) AS changes FROM events
WHERE name = 'lang_changed' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: PWA installs (range)
panels.description: pwa_installed events.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE name = 'pwa_installed' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)

panels.title: Push opt-in rate (range)
panels.description: Share of push permission prompts granted.

targets.rawSql: SELECT avg((props->>'granted')::boolean::int) AS value FROM events WHERE name = 'push_permission' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND props ? 'granted'

panels.title: Feature usage (events in range)
panels.description: Every catalogued customer event in range. Map, radius chips, bill QR scan, wallet, referrals and reviews show here as their events land.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT name AS event, count(*) AS events, count(DISTINCT coalesce(user_id::text, anon_id::text)) AS actors FROM events
WHERE app = 'customer' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 25
